name: ARMOR-ALARM
role: Alarm node and panel: the zones, the arming, the delays, the siren and the PIN of the house's alarm, with the server or without it
stack: C++17 (host-tested core); the ESP32-S3 firmware is not written yet
deployment_target: ESP32-S3 nodes (PoE Ethernet) and a Wi-Fi panel; nothing has been built for a board yet
build: cmake -S tests -B build/host && cmake --build build/host && ctest --test-dir build/host
notes: Only the core exists: what a zone is, how a wired loop with an end-of-line resistor read by the ADC becomes a state (with a debouncer), and the panel's rules - away and stay arming, exit and entry delays, an alarm that latches until a correct disarm, a siren that times out, bypass of open zones when forced, a PIN with lockout and a log of the last hundred events. 492,806 checks on a computer (scripted scenarios and a long random run of the rules that must always hold), and a broken PIN check or siren timeout is caught. There is no firmware, no Zigbee stack, no message with the server and no hardware: nothing has run on a board or on a real installation, and this is not a certified alarm system.
